reason: Machine lens: all opcodes are plain 6502 (LDA #, STA abs, STX abs, JSR abs, BRA/TRB already 65C02 and in use). Removed LDA #imm (2) + STA abs (4) = 6 cycles every execution, 5 bytes; SKIP 5 after the always-taken BRA at &20E9 (never executed) keeps the byte count, so JSR animate_mover stays at &2113, the JSR at &2116 with its low operand at &2117 (move_mover_routine_address_low = *+1 unchanged) and everything after unchanged. The JSR's assembled high byte is HI(move_mover_up_and_right) = &20, equal for all four routines (&20C7-&20D9, ASSERTed); the only store to the high byte (or label+2) in src/ and tools/ is the removed STA. Moved branches: BRA &20E9 offset &20->&25, PC &20EB to &2110 crosses a page as before (&210B); BPL &20FF->&2104, PC &2106, target &210A, same page as before (&2101->&2105); BMI &2109->&210E, PC &2110 to &20DF, crosses as before, offset -&31 in range. No indexed reads in the moved range (zp/imm only). Callers JSR unplot_and_move_mover (2) and JSR move_mover (1) are label-resolved; no label+offset entries into the range. The on-disc operand changes from &FFFF to &20C7, which is overwritten (low byte) before every execution.
